input.summary: Extend TrueLink's indemnity to third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct, with defence and standard procedure.
input.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently covers only its breach of this Agreement, leaving us exposed on third-party IP infringement claims arising from the Interface and related software that TrueLink alone controls. We have added an IP infringement indemnity (with the usual Client Content/modification carve-outs) plus breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct, together with a standard notice-and-control procedure; we can discuss an IP-only indemnity with procure/modify/replace/refund remedies as a fallback.

ops.oldText: claim arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder.
ops.newText: claim arising out of (i) any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder; (ii) any allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any related software or deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a third party, except to the extent such allegation arises from Client Content or from modifications or combinations not made or authorized by TrueLink; (iii) any violation of applicable law by TrueLink; (iv) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or Client Confidential Information caused by TrueLink; or (v) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. TrueLink shall defend any such claim, provided that Client gives TrueLink prompt written notice of the claim, TrueLink has sole control of the defense and settlement (subject to Client's consent to any settlement imposing liability on Client), and Client provides reasonable cooperation at TrueLink's expense.
